name: tortoise-scroll
description: Local-first personal trading journal (TradeZella-style) with AI trading partner

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.e2e:install: npm install --prefix e2e && npm run install-browsers --prefix e2e
